```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: Load packages and read your Statcast dataset
# --------------------------------------------------------
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Read in your file
pitch <- read_csv("Unnecessary Documents/pitching .csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Peek at structure
glimpse(pitch)

# Make sure column names include: Pitcher, Year, IP, ERA, etc.
# If not, adjust names like below:
# pitch <- pitch %>% rename(Pitcher = Name, Year = Season, IP = InningsPitched)

# --------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Convert types and clean numeric columns
# --------------------------------------------------------
pitch <- pitch %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    IP = as.numeric(IP)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3: Filter pitchers with enough innings per season
# --------------------------------------------------------
min_IP <- 50  # You can change this to 40, 60, etc.
qualified <- pitch %>%
  filter(IP >= min_IP)

# --------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Keep only pitchers that appear in ALL three seasons
# --------------------------------------------------------
consistent_pitchers <- qualified %>%
  group_by(Pitcher) %>%
  filter(all(c(2022, 2023, 2024) %in% Year)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5: Check how many pitchers remain
# --------------------------------------------------------
consistent_pitchers %>%
  summarise(unique_pitchers = n_distinct(Pitcher))

# Optional: verify a few random pitchers
consistent_pitchers %>%
  filter(Pitcher %in% sample(unique(Pitcher), 5)) %>%
  arrange(Pitcher, Year)

# --------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: Save the cleaned dataset
# --------------------------------------------------------
write_csv(consistent_pitchers, "consistent_pitchers_2022_2024.csv")

# Now you can run t-tests or ANOVA on these consistent pitchers

```

```{r}
pitch_tempo <- read_csv("pitching_stats_tempo.csv")

pitch_tempo |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  summarise(
    mean_empty_tempo = mean(`Empty Tempo`, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_runners_tempo = mean(`Runners Tempo`, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# Define the stats to use for pitch_strength
pitch_tempo <- pitch_tempo |>
    mutate(
      pitch_strength = scale(`K%`) + -scale(BB) + -scale(HR) + scale(`Whiff%`) + -scale(xwOBA) + -scale(`AVG EV`) + -scale(`Hard Hit%`) + scale(`First Strike%`) + scale(`GB%`))
```

```{r}
baseline_2022 <- pitch_tempo |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  transmute(
    player_id,
    pitch_speed_empty22   = if_else(`Empty Tempo`   <= 18.1234,  "Fast", "Slow",  missing = NA_character_),
    pitch_speed_runners22 = if_else(`Runners Tempo` <= 23.25745, "Fast", "Slow",  missing = NA_character_)
  )

# 3) Attach those baseline labels to ALL seasons
pitch_tempo <- pitch_tempo |>
  left_join(baseline_2022, by = "player_id")

pitch_tempo |>
  filter(Year == 2022) |>
  summarise(
    num_slow_empty = sum(pitch_speed_empty22 == 'Slow'),
    num_fast_empty = sum(pitch_speed_empty22 == 'Fast'),
    num_slow_runners = sum(pitch_speed_runners22 == 'Slow'),
    num_fast_runners = sum(pitch_speed_runners22 == 'Fast')
            )
```

```{r}

# Paired t-test for 2022 vs 2023
paired_22_23 <- pitch_tempo |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2023)) |>
  select(player_id, Year, pitch_strength) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = pitch_strength) |>
  drop_na()

t.test(paired_22_23$`2023`, paired_22_23$`2022`, paired = TRUE)


paired_22_24 <- pitch_tempo |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2022, 2024)) |>
  select(player_id, Year, pitch_strength) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = pitch_strength) |>
  drop_na()

t.test(paired_22_24$`2024`, paired_22_24$`2022`, paired = TRUE)


paired_23_24 <- pitch_tempo |>
  filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024)) |>
  select(player_id, Year, pitch_strength) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = pitch_strength) |>
  drop_na()

t.test(paired_23_24$`2024`, paired_23_24$`2023`, paired = TRUE)
```

```{r}
t.test(
  pitch_strength ~ pitch_speed_empty22,
  data = subset(pitch_tempo, Year == 2022)
)


t.test(
  pitch_strength ~ pitch_speed_empty22,
  data = subset(pitch_tempo, Year == 2023)
)


t.test(
  pitch_strength ~ pitch_speed_empty22,
  data = subset(pitch_tempo, Year == 2024)
)

```

```{r}
# Filter only the slow pitchers (based on 2022 runner tempo)
slow_pitchers_runners22_23 <- pitch_tempo %>%
  filter(pitch_speed_runners22 == "Slow", Year %in% c(2022, 2023)) %>%
  select(player_id, Pitcher, Year, pitch_strength)

# Reshape so each pitcher has both seasons side-by-side
slow_wide_runners22_23 <- slow_pitchers_runners22_23 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = pitch_strength, names_prefix = "pitch_strength_")

# Run paired t-test
t.test(slow_wide_runners22_23$pitch_strength_2023, slow_wide_runners22_23$pitch_strength_2022, paired = TRUE)





#Fast
fast_pitchers_runners22_23 <- pitch_tempo %>%
  filter(pitch_speed_empty22 == "Fast", Year %in% c(2022, 2023)) %>%
  select(player_id, Pitcher, Year, pitch_strength)

fast_wide_runners22_23 <- fast_pitchers_runners22_23 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = pitch_strength, names_prefix = "pitch_strength_")

t.test(fast_wide_runners22_23$pitch_strength_2023, fast_wide_runners22_23$pitch_strength_2022, paired = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# compute mean pitch_strength by group/year
ps_summary <- pitch_tempo %>%
  filter(!is.na(pitch_speed_runners22)) %>%  # using runners-based grouping
  group_by(Year, pitch_speed_runners22) %>%
  summarise(mean_strength = mean(pitch_strength, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ps_summary$pitch_speed_runners22 <- factor(
  ps_summary$pitch_speed_runners22,
  levels = c("Fast", "Slow"),
  labels = c("Fast Pitchers", "Slow Pitchers")
)

ggplot(ps_summary, aes(x = Year, y = mean_strength, 
                       color = pitch_speed_runners22,
                       group = pitch_speed_runners22)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Pitch Strength by Tempo Group (2022–2024)",
    subtitle = "Pitch strength dropped in 2023, especially for slow pitchers",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Pitch Strength",
    color = "Tempo Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)


```
